en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 10.ʿAbdullāh ibn Mughīrah narrated from Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Zayd who attributed the statement to Amīr al-Muʾminīn (a) that when he was asked, “What is detachment (al-zuhd) from the world?”
He said, “[It pertains to] what is forbidden thereof – so restrain yourself from it and shun it.”[1]
